title: Data Analysis Using Python
subtitle: Master data wrangling, exploratory analysis, visualization, and statistical hypothesis testing using NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, and Seaborn.

phases.title: NumPy, Pandas & Data Ingestion
phases.description: Setting up the analysis environment, NumPy arrays, Pandas DataFrames, and reading data from CSV, Excel, JSON, and SQL.

nodes.title: NumPy Arrays & Vectorized Operations
nodes.description: NumPy array creation, indexing, slicing, broadcasting, and vectorized mathematical operations for numerical computing.
topics: Setting up Python environment: Anaconda, Jupyter Notebook, VS Code
NumPy array creation: np.array, np.zeros, np.ones, np.arange, np.linspace
Indexing, slicing, boolean masking, and fancy indexing
Vectorized operations and broadcasting rules
Universal functions (ufuncs): np.sum, np.mean, np.std, np.where
Reshaping, stacking, and splitting arrays
checklist: Create a 2D matrix and perform matrix multiplication.
Use boolean masking to filter values above a threshold.
Benchmark vectorized NumPy operations vs Python loops.

nodes.title: Pandas DataFrames, Series & Data Ingestion
nodes.description: Pandas Series and DataFrame creation, indexing, reading CSV/Excel/JSON/SQL data sources.
topics: Pandas Series and DataFrame fundamentals
Indexing: .loc, .iloc, boolean filtering
Reading data: pd.read_csv, pd.read_excel, pd.read_json, pd.read_sql
Writing data back to CSV, Excel, and JSON
DataFrame info, dtypes, describe, and head/tail inspection
Setting and resetting index
checklist: Load a real-world CSV dataset and inspect it with .info() and .describe().
Filter rows using multi-condition boolean expressions.
Export a transformed DataFrame to CSV and Excel.

phases.title: Data Cleaning & Preprocessing
phases.description: Handling missing values, duplicates, outliers, type conversions, and feature scaling.

nodes.title: Data Cleaning: Missing Values, Duplicates & Type Conversions
nodes.description: Detecting and handling missing data, removing duplicates, and correcting inconsistent data types.
topics: Detecting missing values: .isnull(), .isna(), .notna()
Imputation strategies: mean, median, mode, forward/backward fill
Dropping rows and columns: .dropna() with threshold
Identifying and removing duplicate rows: .duplicated(), .drop_duplicates()
Data type conversions: .astype(), pd.to_datetime(), pd.to_numeric()
String cleaning: .str.strip(), .str.lower(), regex replacement

resources.title: Pandas Data Cleaning Guide — Real Python

checklist: Detect and impute missing values with column-specific strategies.
Remove duplicate rows and document cleaning decisions.
Convert a date string column to datetime and extract month/year.

nodes.title: Outlier Detection & Feature Scaling
nodes.description: Statistical outlier detection (Z-score, IQR), and feature normalization techniques for ML preprocessing.
topics: Z-score outlier detection and removal
IQR (Interquartile Range) fence-based outlier filtering
Min-Max Normalization (0-1 scaling)
Standardization (Z-score scaling, mean=0, std=1)
Robust scaling for outlier-resistant normalization
Handling categorical data: one-hot encoding, label encoding
checklist: Identify outliers in a dataset using the IQR method.
Apply Min-Max and StandardScaler normalization.
One-hot encode a categorical column.

phases.title: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) & Visualization
phases.description: Grouping, aggregation, pivot tables, Matplotlib plots, Seaborn heatmaps, and statistical EDA.

nodes.title: EDA: Groupby, Aggregation & Pivot Tables
nodes.description: Descriptive statistics, groupby aggregations, merging DataFrames, and building pivot table summaries.
topics: Descriptive statistics: mean, median, mode, variance, std deviation
groupby() with aggregate functions: sum, mean, count, agg()
Merging and joining DataFrames: inner, left, right, outer joins
Concatenating and appending DataFrames
Pivot tables and crosstab analysis
Correlation matrix and covariance analysis
checklist: Group a sales dataset by region and compute monthly revenue aggregates.

Build a pivot table showing average sales by product category.

nodes.title: Data Visualization with Matplotlib & Seaborn
nodes.description: Creating publication-quality charts using Matplotlib and Seaborn for distributions, relationships, and comparisons.

Subplots: plt.subplots(), fig and axes objects
Seaborn: boxplots, violin plots, heatmaps, pairplots, stripplots
Customizing plots: titles, labels, legends, color palettes, grid styles
Visualizing distributions and feature relationships
Saving high-resolution plots for reports
checklist: Create a Seaborn heatmap of the correlation matrix.

Confidence intervals and margin of error
